Who are We?

Inspired by Nurses, for Nurses

At MedGear, we don’t design scrubs in boardrooms. We go straight to real nurses and ask, “What would your dream scrubs look like?” Then we build them together.

Every pocket, stitch, and fabric choice is based on real feedback from nurses on the job. The result? Scrubs that actually work for you.

Women-owned. Nurse-crafted. Purpose-driven.

This is MedGear. Made with you.
